name: Alila Seminyak
short_description: A 176-room beachfront Alila resort in Petitenget, north Seminyak, with four pools and the Seasalt restaurant.
ai_summary: Alila Seminyak sits on the beach in Petitenget, at the quieter northern end of Seminyak, with 176 rooms and suites including beach and garden suites and an 8,729-square-foot penthouse. Guests consistently praise the highly professional, attentive staff and the buffet breakfast at Seasalt restaurant, calling views from the rooms, restaurant, and pools spectacular. Some reviewers note the rooms are starting to show their age, with dampness and door-gap issues in places, and caution that swimming conditions and beach cleanliness at this stretch of coast can vary.

faqs.question: Is Alila Seminyak actually in Seminyak?
faqs.answer: It's in Petitenget, the quieter, more upscale northern end of Seminyak, on the beach -- a short drive or walk from Seminyak's main strip of bars and restaurants rather than in the middle of the busiest area.

faqs.question: What's the cheapest way to stay at Alila Seminyak with World of Hyatt points?
faqs.answer: The Studios category, a separate lower-cost room type from the main resort, has been available from around 5,000 World of Hyatt points per night in past redemptions, though guests check in at the main resort and use a golf cart to reach them.

reviews.title: Review: Studios At Alila Seminyak
reviews.summary: Finds the Studios category excellent value at 5,000 World of Hyatt points per night, with spacious, modern rooms and access to the main resort's pools, though guests must check in at the main property and use a golf cart to reach them.
